prompts.prompt-nw-sleep-patch-v1.txt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a small production animation patch atlas with FOUR sprites ONLY, 2 columns x 2 rows, four equal square cells on a truly transparent background. It will replace four cells in the reference atlas. Match exactly the silver-white cat's identity and crisp blocky pixel-art style in the first reference. Second reference is her actual photo. No text, no grid lines, no labels, no shadows.

LEFT COLUMN: two phases of the SAME north-west walking animation. Both sprites face upper-left AWAY from the viewer. Rear-left three-quarter view: you see both ears from behind, the back of the head, silver-grey back, rear legs, the tail emerges to lower-right. NO eyes visible, NO face visible. Head at upper-left, rear at lower-right. First frame lifts left front/right rear paws. Second frame lifts right front/left rear paws. Same pose direction, same head/tail placement and silhouette size, just alternating steps, smooth two-frame loop.

RIGHT COLUMN: two frames of a curled sleeping animation. BOTH sprites curled in the EXACT SAME side-view pose: head at LEFT, nose pointed down to front paws at left; rounded back to RIGHT, tail wrapped in front, both eyes peacefully closed. Top frame breathing out, lower frame breathing in very slightly. Same orientation, no rotation, no head turning, same whole body shape except a tiny raised back in bottom frame.

Silver-white dense fur, subtle grey stripes, muted grey outlines, pink-brown nose; preserve original cat design. Strong simple hard-edged pixel clusters, limited colors, absolutely no blur, no antialiasing, no thin fuzzy halo. All sprite interiors fully opaque. All empty pixels truly transparent. Each complete sprite centered in the inner 80% of its own square cell, neither tails nor ears touch cell boundaries.
prompts.prompt-v1.txt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production pixel-art sprite sheet for a macOS desktop cat, 32 animation frames.
Input images: photos 1 and 2 are the identity reference for the same female cat named Piaopiao; image 3 is the approved pixel-art STYLE reference ONLY, ignore all board typography, UI, palette bars and framing.

Generate ONE true transparent PNG sprite atlas, landscape exactly 2:1 aspect ratio, 2048 x 1024 if possible. EXACTLY 8 equal columns by 4 equal rows, 32 equal square cells, completely invisible grid. Every cell contains one isolated full-body sprite of the SAME silver-white short-haired round-faced cat. Yellow-green eyes with dark rims, little pink-brown nose, subtle gray forehead stripes and gray striped tail, white chest. No collar, no clothes. Cute but faithful to her photos. Crisp genuine low-resolution pixel-art aesthetic, blocky hard-edged clusters, limited muted gray-white/olive/pink palette, dark gray outline, no soft painting and no antialiasing. Each cat fits entirely inside the middle 82% of its own cell with generous transparent margins; no sprite touching a neighbor or a cell border. Consistent character size and center-of-mass across all frames; paws baseline consistent within pairs. The frames must be visibly different phases when paired.

Direction convention: N = away from viewer toward top of screen, seeing the cat's back and both ears, NEVER front face. S = toward viewer and bottom, front face visible. E = right-facing profile; W = left-facing profile. NE/NW = rear three-quarter view; SE/SW = front three-quarter view. Natural quadruped WALK poses, not only standing.

Precise cell contents in row-major order, read each row left to right:
TOP ROW (row 0): [0] scratching an invisible north wall, rear view, both forepaws raised, phase A; [1] walking NW rear-left three-quarter, left steps A; [2] sleeping curled compactly, eyes closed, phase A; [3] walking E right profile, alternating legs phase A; [4] scratching invisible west wall to left, left-facing profile upright forepaws, phase A; [5] sitting scratching own ear using hind paw, phase A; [6] sitting scratching own ear using hind paw, phase B; [7] sitting scratching own ear using hind paw, phase C.
ROW 1: [0] scratch north wall phase B; [1] walk NW phase B; [2] sleeping curled, breathing phase B; [3] walk E phase B; [4] scratch west wall phase B; [5] walk SE front-right three-quarter phase A; [6] walk SW front-left three-quarter phase B; [7] scratching invisible south wall, front view forepaws up phase A.
ROW 2: [0] walk NE rear-right three-quarter phase A; [1] walk N directly away rear view phase A; [2] scratching invisible east wall on right, right profile forepaws raised phase A; [3] tired seated with half-closed eyes; [4] walk W left profile phase A; [5] walk SE front-right phase B; [6] scratch south wall front view forepaws up phase B; [7] walk S directly toward viewer phase B.
BOTTOM ROW (row 3): [0] walk NE rear-right phase B; [1] walk N directly away rear view phase B; [2] scratch east wall right profile phase B; [3] idle seated upright with front paws together, gentle open eyes; [4] walk W left profile phase B; [5] walk SW front-left phase A; [6] walk S directly toward viewer phase A; [7] alert seated with upright ears and attentive open eyes.

Hard constraints: exact 32 cells occupied exactly once. True alpha transparency in every inter-sprite gap, no checkerboard painted into the image. NO text, NO labels, NO numbers, NO logos, NO watermarks, NO grid lines, NO floor, NO shadows, NO props. Draw no actual walls, only scratching poses. All silhouettes, ears, whiskers, paws and tails must be fully contained. This is an actual game sprite atlas, NOT a presentation sheet or mood board.
prompts.prompt-v2.txt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the first reference image is a 32-frame pixel cat sprite atlas. Supporting identity/style references: second image is the cat photo; third is the approved pixel style.

Make a clean corrected production version of this SAME atlas. Preserve the cat identity, silver-white fur, yellow-green eyes, grey forehead markings, same pixel style, same exact 8 columns x 4 rows, same 32 actions in the same cells, same 2:1 overall shape and same consistent size. Real transparent background. No text, no grid, no labels.

Perform these targeted corrections:
1. Top row, SECOND cell (column 1,row0): this must face NORTH-WEST, upper-left away from viewer, cat head at upper LEFT and tail toward lower RIGHT. Match the direction of the cell immediately BELOW it (column1,row1), but with alternate leg step. Currently this sprite points to upper right, which is incorrect.
2. Sleeping pair in THIRD column at row0 and row1: both must have head to the same LEFT side, tucked near front paws, exactly the same curled silhouette, eyes closed. Difference is only a tiny breathing rise/fall. No turning the head to the other side.
3. Make all silhouette edges clean hard-edged dark grey pixel outlines. Remove any red or yellow halo specks entirely. All fully filled sprite interiors should be fully opaque; every pixel outside the silhouettes should be fully transparent. No colored contamination around edges, no floor shadow, no painted checkerboard. Crisp limited-palette pixel clusters, not smudged texture. All 32 cats keep full body and tail inside own cell; generous transparent margins.

Do not change any other cell's action or facing direction. Do not invent extra characters. This is a production sprite atlas.
